_note: Company-level facts that live outside the /resources/ docs tree. Verified 2026-11-01 against iomete.com/about-us and the track's own starter kit PDF.

facts.quote: In 2021, they partnered up to start IOMETE.

facts.statement: IOMETE went through Y Combinator in early 2022
facts.quote: Together, they went through Y Combinator in early 2022 and the rest is history.

facts.statement: The table format is Apache Iceberg
facts.quote: IOMETE is built on Kubernetes , Apache Spark , and Apache Iceberg : three technologies designed to scale horizontally

facts.statement: The platform runs on Kubernetes and the compute engine is Apache Spark

antifacts.wrong: Says the tables are Delta Lake
antifacts.correction: The table format is Apache Iceberg, not Delta Lake. Delta is Databricks' format; IOMETE's open-format story depends on Iceberg.
antifacts.quote: IOMETE is a state-of-the-art, fast, scalable, user-friendly Data Lakehouse Platform for AI and Analytics .

wrong_pattern: control plane runs in our cloud
our cloud and only the data plane
only the data plane is in your
antifacts.wrong: Says IOMETE's control plane runs in IOMETE's cloud
antifacts.correction: The platform operates entirely inside the customer's infrastructure. Both control plane and data plane are deployed in the customer's own Kubernetes.
antifacts.quote: The platform operates entirely within your infrastructure, ensuring that no data is sent outside of your organization.

antifacts.wrong: Frames IOMETE as a hosted SaaS product
antifacts.correction: IOMETE is self-hosted: it deploys into the customer's own infrastructure, own cloud account, hybrid or air-gapped.
antifacts.quote: It offers flexibility and can be deployed anywhere – on-premises, in the cloud, or in a hybrid environment.

antifacts.wrong: Says the platform needs public internet access to operate
antifacts.correction: A fully air-gapped deployment is a supported mode with no outbound internet.
antifacts.quote: It runs on your own Kubernetes, on-premises, in your cloud account or air-gapped.

antifacts.wrong: Says the whole platform is open source and can be self-supported
antifacts.correction: The components are open source (Spark, Iceberg, Kubernetes) and the table format is open, but the public docs make no claim that the whole platform is open source or free.
antifacts.quote: IOMETE is a state-of-the-art, fast, scalable, user-friendly Data Lakehouse Platform for AI and Analytics .

antifacts.wrong: Says the table layer is Apache Hudi
antifacts.correction: The table format is Apache Iceberg. Hudi is a different open table format and not part of IOMETE's platform.
antifacts.quote: IOMETE is built on Kubernetes , Apache Spark , and Apache Iceberg : three technologies designed to scale horizontally

antifacts.wrong: Says the storage or table format is proprietary
antifacts.correction: Iceberg is an open table format: the data sits as standard files in the customer's own storage and stays readable without IOMETE.
antifacts.quote: IOMETE is built on Kubernetes , Apache Spark , and Apache Iceberg : three technologies designed to scale horizontally
